good_ending_plus

← Back to Reading MAM-parsed-plus

The good_ending_plus field houses the מ:סיום בטוב template, which is documented on a dedicated page.

Example object

Example from Isaiah (book39 level). The good_ending_plus object includes last_chapnver and wikitext_element.

 1{
 2  "last_chapnver": ["66", "24"],
 3  "wikitext_element": {
 4    "tmpl_name": "נוסח",
 5    "tmpl_params": {
 6      "1": {
 7        "tmpl_name": "מ:סיום בטוב",
 8        "tmpl_params": {"1": "והיה מדי ... אמר יהוה"}
 9      },
10      "2": "=מנהג יפה ... בכתי\"ל)."
11    }
12  }
13}
Line 8
Unpointed text of 66:23 (the next-to-last verse of Isaiah)
Line 10
Documentation note on the good-ending tradition
